title: 馬克白 5-2~9 最終決戰
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek

panels.prompt: {characters}, in half-buckled armor pacing a war room strewn with maps and candles, cowering servants at the edge of the torchlight

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 讓他們一個個逃走吧！除非勃南森林會向鄧西嫩移動，我不知道有什麼值得害怕。
dialogue.en: Let them fly all: till Birnam Wood remove to Dunsinane I cannot taint with fear.

panels.prompt: an old robed doctor bowing nervously in a torchlit doorway, avoiding the king's eyes

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 大夫，夫人治不好——那就把我的國家驗一驗，找出它的病根吧。
dialogue.en: If thou couldst, doctor, cast the water of my land, find her disease.

panels.prompt: a vast army at the edge of a great forest at dawn, thousands of soldiers hacking leafy boughs from the trees and hoisting them, mist between the trunks

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 每個兵士都砍下一根樹枝，舉在身前——隱去我們全軍的人數。
dialogue.en: Let every soldier hew him down a bough and bear't before him.

panels.prompt: Macduff, a burly thane with a thick unkempt red-brown beard, a jagged boar-tusk pendant at his neck, in a weathered grey-green tartan cloak, gripping his sword hilt, eyes burning with grief and resolve

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 少說推測的話。眼前，讓我們發揚戰士的堅毅精神。
dialogue.en: Make we our march towards Birnam. Put we on industrious soldiership.

panels.prompt: a torchlit castle corridor, women's cries echoing from deeper rooms, a grizzled old officer lowering his head before the king

dialogue.speaker: 西登
dialogue.text: 陛下——王后死了。
dialogue.en: The queen, my lord, is dead.

panels.prompt: {characters}, standing utterly still on castle battlements at dusk, wind pulling at his cloak, face emptied of everything, a vast grey sky

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 她反正要死的——遲早，總會有聽到這個消息的一天。
dialogue.en: She should have died hereafter; there would have been a time for such a word.

panels.prompt: vast full-page panel, a lone armored king small on dark battlements under an immense empty sky, a single guttering candle flame superimposed huge and translucent against the storm clouds, his shadow stretching long and thin across the stones like a stage actor's

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 明天，明天，再一個明天，一天接著一天躡步前進，直到最後一秒鐘的時間。人生不過是一個行走的影子，一個愚人所講的故事，充滿著喧嘩和騷動，卻找不到一點意義。
dialogue.en: Tomorrow, and tomorrow, and tomorrow, creeps in this petty pace from day to day, to the last syllable of recorded time. Life's but a walking shadow … it is a tale told by an idiot, full of sound and fury, signifying nothing.

quote.text: 人生不過是一個行走的影子

panels.prompt: narrow panel, a candle flame snuffed by wind, a thin thread of smoke rising in darkness

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 熄滅了吧，熄滅了吧，短促的燭光！
dialogue.en: Out, out, brief candle!

panels.prompt: a terrified messenger on a watchtower pointing at the horizon, mouth open mid-shout

dialogue.speaker: 使者
dialogue.text: 我向勃南望去——那邊的樹木……開始移動了！
dialogue.en: As I did stand my watch upon the hill, I looked toward Birnam, and anon methought the wood began to move.

panels.prompt: {characters}, gripping the messenger by the collar then staring past him, in the far distance a dark treeline crawling toward the castle, his certainty cracking on his scarred face

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 「不要害怕，除非勃南森林會到鄧西嫩」——現在，一座樹林真的來了。敲起警鐘！吹吧狂風，來吧滅亡！
dialogue.en: 'Fear not, till Birnam Wood do come to Dunsinane', and now a wood comes toward Dunsinane. Ring the alarum-bell! Blow, wind! Come, wrack!

panels.prompt: before the castle gates, an army casting down their leafy camouflage boughs to reveal ranks of soldiers and siege ladders, arrows and smoke filling the sky

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 拋下你們樹葉的幕障，現出威武的軍容來！
dialogue.en: Your leafy screens throw down, and show like those you are.

panels.prompt: {characters}, cutting down a young knight in the smoke of a burning courtyard, embers swirling

dialogue.speaker: 小西華德
dialogue.text: 你這暴君！
dialogue.en: Thou liest, abhorred tyrant!

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 你是婦人所生的——我瞧不起一切婦人之子的刀劍。
dialogue.en: Thou wast born of woman. But swords I smile at, brandished by man that's of a woman born.

panels.prompt: Macduff, a burly thane with a thick unkempt red-brown beard, a jagged boar-tusk pendant at his neck, in a weathered grey-green tartan cloak, bursting through battle smoke with sword drawn, face streaked with ash and grief

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 轉過來，地獄裡的惡狗——轉過來！
dialogue.en: Turn, hell-hound, turn!

panels.prompt: {characters}, turning slowly in the burning courtyard, lowering his sword a fraction, weariness and dread in his eyes

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 所有人裡，我最不願見的就是你。回去吧——你一家人的血，已經沾得我的靈魂太多了。
dialogue.en: Of all men else I have avoided thee. But get thee back; my soul is too much charged with blood of thine already.

panels.prompt: two warriors locked blade to blade in the firelight, sparks flying, a red-bearded face inches from the tyrant's scarred one

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 別再信你的魔法了。讓你信奉的神告訴你——麥克德夫，是沒有足月就從母親腹中剖出來的。
dialogue.en: Despair thy charm, and let the angel whom thou still hast served tell thee: Macduff was from his mother's womb untimely ripped.

quote.text: 麥克德夫不是婦人所生
quote.en: From his mother's womb untimely ripped.

panels.prompt: {characters}, staggering back a step in the burning courtyard, sword point dropping, the world tilting around him

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 願告訴我這句話的舌頭受咒詛！這些魔鬼用模稜兩可的話愚弄我們——聽來大有希望，結果完全相反。
dialogue.en: Accursed be that tongue that tells me so … and be these juggling fiends no more believed, that palter with us in a double sense.

panels.prompt: final clash silhouetted against a burning castle, two swords crossing in a blaze of white light, embers streaming upward into the night

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 我不投降。雖然勃南森林到了鄧西嫩，你也不是婦人所生——我還要擎起盾牌，戰到最後。來，麥克德夫！
dialogue.en: I will not yield. Though Birnam Wood be come to Dunsinane, and thou opposed, being of no woman born, yet I will try the last. Lay on, Macduff!

quote.text: 誰先喊「住手，夠了」，讓他在地獄裡沉淪
quote.en: Damned be him that first cries 'Hold, enough!'

panels.prompt: dawn over a quiet battlefield, a crown raised high by many hands before ranks of weary soldiers, and far away on the misty moor three tiny hunched silhouettes watching before dissolving into fog

dialogue.speaker: 眾人
dialogue.text: 祝福，蘇格蘭的國王！
dialogue.en: Hail, King of Scotland!

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 荒野上，霧又合攏了。
dialogue.en: On the moor, the fog closes again.
